# cyclé

Two jobs in one file, because they are the same job.

The non-ASCII filename the testing contract asks every golden tree to carry.
The closure is the one artifact that maps names to names, so an accented or
decomposed filename that no reference can match is a miss no other source would
reveal.

And one end of the deliberate cycle: this file names ../entry.md, and the entry
file names this one. That is not an exotic shape — a skill pointing at a
reference file that points back at the skill is how progressive disclosure is
actually written, so the walk has to terminate on it and the closure must not
depend on which end it was entered from.
